title: Mirabel: Pastoral Hillside Song (Mirabel)
cultural_context: Pastoral highland ballad celebrating the beauty of high meadow flora, clear hillside streams, and rustic village life, from 'Ka Phawar Beh Sbai'.

khasi: Ha pneh ki lum ba jyrngam,
Ka rwai ka sur ba kynjai;
Ki syntiew ki phuh ha ka them,
Ki pyniwbih ia ka lyer ba pyngngad;
Ki masi ki bam phlang ha madan,
Dei ka jingim ba suk bad ba shida
Ba u Blei u la theh ha ka ri.
english: In the lap of the emerald green hills,
There echoes a song of peaceful calm;
Wild flowers blossom across the vale,
Imparting sweet fragrance to the refreshing breeze;
Cattle graze peacefully upon highland meadows,
Children play tunes on the little Duitara;
This is the serene, modest life
Which God has poured upon our mountain land.

khasi: Wat la ka pyrthei ka phet sting,
Sha ki buit ba stad ka juk mynta;
Ka dohnud jong ngi kan iaineh
Ha kane ka jingsuk ba pura;
Rwai, ko Mirabel, rwai la ka sur,
Ia ka nam jong ka Meiramew;
Ba ka burom jong ki lum Khasi
Kan im ha man ka jingshai.
english: Though the hurried world rushes fast,
Chasing the cunning technologies of today;
Our inner hearts shall remain steadfast
In this pure and untroubled peace;
Sing on, Mirabel, sing your sweet song,
Praising the glory of Mother Earth;
So that the majesty of the Khasi hills
Shall thrive in every morning light.
